title: BoJ Minutes — October 29-30, 2026 MPM (the Outlook meeting's full record)
source: EST: boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/ ('Monetary Policy Meetings'), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 41,959 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its two year tables by this session. Against the header 'Date of MPM | Outlook Report (The Bank's View) | Summary of Opinions | MPM Minutes', the 2026 October row parses exactly as ['Oct. 29 (Thurs.), 30 (Fri.)', 'Oct. 30 (Fri.)', 'Nov. 10 (Tues.)', 'Dec. 23 (Wed.)'] — i.e. the full Minutes of the October 2026 MPM publish 2026-12-23. The same page states the release time verbatim: 'MPM Minutes It will be released at 8:50 a.m.', which is 08:50 JST Wed 2026-12-23 = 18:50 EST Tue 2026-12-22. Filed estimate on two counts, identical to the nine BoJ entries already on this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: for the Federal Reserve and no slot for the Bank of Japan, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep.
notes: DISCOVERED during the boj-summary-of-opinions-2026-12-28 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), and filed because it inverts that event's own framing rather than merely adding to it. That ledger's calendar note assumed the next BoJ text after the 2026-12-28 Summary of Opinions was the December meeting's full Minutes on 2027-01-27, five weeks later. It is not: this document publishes five days BEFORE the Summary, and it is the materially richer one. The October 29-30 MPM carried an Outlook Report (the schedule's Outlook column reads 'Oct. 30 (Fri.)'), so these Minutes are the complete, attributed record of a projection-round meeting — the policy debate in full, opinions tied to speakers. The 2026-12-28 Summary of Opinions is by construction an unattributed digest of a meeting that carried no Outlook (its column reads '-'). On any information ranking, 12-23 is the document worth reading and 12-28 is not. Note also that this is the SECOND independent sighting of the same structure: boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29 found the January-MPM Minutes landing 2027-03-24, five days before its own Summary, from a different table row. Two instances from two lanes suggests a general property of the BoJ release schedule — the Minutes of meeting N-1 fall inside the corridor of the Summary of meeting N — rather than a coincidence at either venue, and the next pulse on either event should test it as a rule. Impact is LOW: symbols is empty, no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed, and the BoJ channel to this calendar's AI names runs through yen funding and global term premium, both second-order for a US equity book and both already owned by the FOMC ledgers. The 12-23 US session is separately crowded — PCE (confirmed, high), GDP Q3 third estimate (confirmed) and advance durable goods all print that morning — so nothing in that tape is attributable to Tokyo without ruling those out first. Precedent for filing a central-bank meeting-account release as its own entry: boj-minutes-2027-03-24, boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29, fomc-minutes-2026-12-30 and ecb-account-2026-10-08, all kind 'macro-print'.
